name: Bone Ward raises a minion's armor by 50%, not twice that (#4006)
contract: #4006: casting Bone Ward 681529 on a level-6 Lesser Skeletal Warrior raised its armor from 14 to 32 (x2.2857) instead of the documented 14 to 21 (x1.5, 'Armor is increased by $s2%' per Spell.dbc Description). Effect index 1 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE_PCT, +50%) targets TARGET_UNIT_CASTER; effect index 2 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_TOTAL_STAT_PERCENTAGE, +10% stamina) is the custom SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_APPLY_AURA_TO_SUMMONS (190), which the engine (SpellAuras.cpp, SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_APPLY_AURA_TO_SUMMONS case) already propagates natively from the player's own aura onto every owned summon. AscensionNecromancerAuras.cpp's aura_ascension_necromancer_lifecycle::Apply additionally copied the WHOLE spell onto every minion with player->AddAura(id, minion), duplicating effect index 2 on top of the native propagation while also granting effect index 1, which native propagation does not cover (the fix keeps that half: it is the only way the tooltip's minion-armor promise reaches minions at all). The fix restricts that manual copy's effect mask to exclude whichever effect index carries SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_APPLY_AURA_TO_SUMMONS, leaving the native engine solely responsible for propagating that one effect and the manual copy solely responsible for the rest (here, only the armor effect, since the proc-trigger effect 0 is not asserted by this scenario). The same fix applies to AscensionNecromancerSummons.cpp's identical copy made when a minion is summoned while a ward is already active. A fresh Lesser Skeletal Warrior's pre-ward armor is captured as an independent baseline so the assertion does not depend on a hardcoded creature_template value.

steps.label: SETUP: the Lesser Skeletal Warrior is raised
Baseline minion armor before any Ward
Baseline caster armor before any Ward
CONTROL: the caster's own armor still rises by the documented 50%
DISCRIMINATING: the minion's armor rises by 50% (x1.5), not the duplicated x2.2857 before the fix
